visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young woman with long dark hair standing in a sun-drenched outdoor setting. Pine trees and green foliage are visible in the background as a gentle breeze blows her hair. She smiles directly at the camera while Traditional Chinese text overlays describe the 'daily eye makeup' theme. (2) The scene transitions to an indoor studio with neutral gray lighting. The woman is shown in a tight close-up, touching her face and lips with her hands to display her natural skin and base makeup. She is now wearing a white top and a brown headband, looking poised and elegant. (3) The camera captures a top-down shot of various I'M MEME Multi Cube makeup palettes scattered on a light-colored surface. The translucent plastic cases reveal different combinations of eyeshadows and blushes. Numbered labels from #01 to #09 appear as variety-show style text overlays to introduce the product line. (4) In a series of instructional close-ups, the woman applies different shades of powder from the Multi Cube using various makeup brushes. The focus is on the precision of her movements around her eyes, applying base colors, darker defining shades, and finally, a shimmering glitter to her lower lids. (5) The video shows a close-up of a forearm with six swatches of lip tint in varying shades of red and pink. Following this, the woman is seen applying the lip tint directly to her lips, using a brush to blend the color for a soft, gradient effect. (6) The woman poses for several shots to show the completed makeup look from different angles. She holds the pink Multi Cube palette close to her cheek, smiling confidently. The lighting is bright and flattering, highlighting the subtle shimmer and color coordination of her makeup. (7) A quick-cut sequence features arm swatches of all nine Multi Cube palettes, transitioning through peach, brown, and purple color stories. Each shot displays four distinct eyeshadow shades and one matching blush shade applied to the inner arm, clearly showcasing the variety of the collection. (8) The final frame presents an arrangement of six Multi Cube palettes on a clean white background. Promotional text overlays provide information about purchasing on the brand's official website, listing the special offer price alongside the original retail price for the featured makeup products.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts immediately with a high-energy, upbeat electronic pop instrumental track. It features a bright, clean synth lead and a driving percussive beat with a tempo around 120 BPM. There are no human voices or environmental sounds, indicating a studio-produced BGM perfectly synced for social media. (2) As the video progresses, the musical theme maintains its rhythmic intensity with a consistent four-on-the-floor beat. The spectral brightness is high, emphasizing the crisp percussion and melodic layers. No incidental sounds from the makeup application process are audible over the loud music, maintaining a pristine and polished commercial sound profile.
